summary: Regression test for MAJOR routes_extended.py refactor (Jan 2026 — ~3,500 lines moved across 5 new router modules + app_state/mem_store shared modules). Backend: 20/20 pytest assertions PASS at /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression_iter192.py. All 5 extracted modules respond on original URL paths with correct behavior — Settings/Profile/Auth-OTP (routes_workshop_config.py), Approvals + Notifications + public-token 404 (routes_approvals.py), COA list/tree/transactions/init-defaults (routes_accounts_extended.py), Invoice-Templates/Print-Render/Templates (routes_templates_extended.py), Technicians GET+POST (routes_technicians.py). Firewall sanity: total_entries=63, balance_health_percent=100, unbalanced 100/50 entry rejected with HTTP 400. Frontend smoke: /accounting/firewall renders all stat cards (health=100%, rejections present, sidebar link 'جدار حماية' visible twice), /accounting/journal-entries renders without React crash (cards + search + sidebar), home loads after login as 'مدير'. 0 console errors, 0 page errors. NO REGRESSIONS — refactor is safe to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is structurally clean: each extracted module exposes a `router` + uses app_state.configure() pattern uniformly. URL paths preserved exactly.
Auth OTP endpoint returns BOTH 'token' and 'whatsappDeeplink' — preserved correctly per request contract.
Public approvals route correctly returns 404 for unknown tokens (verified) — proper not-leaking-info behavior.

Firewall stat cards on the UI panel use in-memory firewall_state (resets on backend restart) — UI shows '0/0 قيد' even though backend supabase has 63 entries. This is pre-existing & documented in iter190/191; UI binds to firewall_state events, not historical supabase counts. Consider adding a small note in the panel header to reduce confusion for auditors after a backend restart (low-priority enhancement, NOT a regression).

/api/templates duplicate-registration exists in BOTH routes_templates.py and routes_templates_extended.py — first include wins (still passes). Add a code comment to record intent (carried over from iter191 review).
routes_extended.py shrunk 8,639 → 5,093 (-41%). Good. Recommend continuing extraction (e.g., invoices, customers, vehicles) in similar fashion to keep file under 3,000 lines.
No new lint/syntax issues found; no MongoDB _id leakage observed in responses tested.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3/3 smoke pages — home, firewall, journal-entries; 0 console + 0 page errors)

rca of the issue: No issues. One initial test failure was a test-side bug: I used '{{ name }}' (with spaces) but the render endpoint matches '{{name}}' (no spaces) literally via str.replace. Fixed test, all 20 pass. The refactor itself is regression-free.
